fields.Participants: Store Manager, Assistant SM, Security Guard, HSE Specialist (VS-24)
fields.Trigger: Typhoon, fire, or earthquake incident occurrence with structural store impact (VS-69)

workflows.name: Disaster Incident Staging and Physical Site Access Control

Automation Opportunity: - Geofenced access control alerts through the corporate security dashboard.
Controls: - CTL-311: detect physical security breaches — disaster-site access control; LP Manager access approvals.
Cross-references: - links to VS-69 (typhoon), VS-24 (HSE), VS-147 (premises liability)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Trespass injury risk**: Public enters damaged site and gets injured, creating corporate liability; mitigated by physical perimeter barriers and 24/7 security guard staging.
System Touchpoints: - Physical security logs, HSE incident module (VS-24.1), access system (VS-27).

steps.activity: Assess immediate threat levels and secure the perimeter with safety barriers.
Verify that all customers and personnel are accounted for per W471.
Deploy temporary signage restricting public entry and establish secure security staging gates.
Issue temporary access badges to certified emergency assessment personnel only.

fields.Owner: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Facilities & Real Estate
fields.Participants: Structural Engineer, Geodetic Engineer, Store Manager, Safety Officer

workflows.name: Rapid Structural Integrity and Safety Assessment

Controls: - CTL-782 (ensure controlled execution — Structural Damage & Insurance Appraisal Coordination (PA-184.1).)
- operational: OHS incident prevention; facilities standards verification.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Premature site clearance risk**: Store cleared for entry while structural elements are weak, risking collapse; mitigated by requiring certified Structural Engineer sign-off on integrity report.
System Touchpoints: - Facilities Maintenance module (VS-20.3), OHS Compliance tracker.

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Conduct visual check of structural elements (roof, beams, load-bearing walls, foundations).

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Verify structural safety using specialized testing equipment (Schmidt rebound hammer, ultrasonic).

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Assess secondary hazards: electrical wire grounding, gas leaks, water main bursts.

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Draft and sign Rapid Structural Integrity Assessment Report; tag site status (Green, Yellow, Red).

fields.Participants: Structural Engineer, Geodetic Engineer, Finance Analyst
fields.Trigger: Rapid Structural Assessment tagged Yellow or Red (W5274)

workflows.name: Detailed Technical Damage Quantification and Geodetic Survey

Controls: - CTL-782: ensure controlled execution — Structural Damage & Insurance Appraisal Coordination (PA-184.1). — CAPA authorization controls; Director, Facilities & Real Estate sign-off required.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Underestimated BOQ risk**: Rebuilding budget is insufficient due to missed structural damages, delaying completion; mitigated by double-checking BOQ against original blueprints (VS-176).

steps.activity: Conduct detailed measurement of damaged structural and architectural elements.
Perform geodetic slope and soil shift surveys to check for land subsidence.
Compile Detailed Bill of Quantities (BOQ) mapping replacement materials, steel, and concrete volumes.
Verify BOQ material costs with current price matrices and generate project estimate.

fields.Participants: Loss Adjuster, Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Chief Accountant (VS-17.1)
fields.Trigger: Approved BOQ and project cost estimate (W5275)

workflows.name: Insurance Loss Adjuster Audit Coordination and Proof of Loss Submission

Automation Opportunity: - Automated claim documentation compiler parsing data directly from asset registers.
Controls: - CTL-34: Complete tax compliance controls; CFO approval on Proof of Loss.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Claim depreciation risk**: Insurance adjuster applies high depreciation rates to replacement costs, lowering payout; mitigated by presenting detailed original cost ledgers (VS-35) and repair quotes.
Time Estimate: - ~10-20 working days for adjuster reviews and final submission

steps.activity: Compile insurance claim packet: incident reports, photos, rapid assessments, BOQ.
Coordinate site visit and inspection with designated Loss Adjuster.
Negotiate damage valuations and present technical engineering evidence.
Draft and execute final Proof of Loss document and submit to insurance carrier.

fields.Participants: Stock Associate, Loss Prevention Officer, Scrap Dealer, Hazmat hauler (VS-114)

workflows.name: Emergency Scrap Defective Inventory and Asset Disposal Routing

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile disposal checklist requiring upload of waste manifest and disposal certificate.
Controls: - CTL-26: Asset disposal controls; DENR manifest matching requirements.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Environmental compliance penalty risk**: Damaged chemical/paint inventory dumped in general waste, violating DENR guidelines; mitigated by utilizing licensed hazardous waste haulers (VS-114).

steps.activity: Verify that insurance adjusters have cleared materials for disposal.
Segregate scrap steel, lumber, and copper wire; contact scrap dealer.
Identify hazardous materials (damaged paints, solvents) and route to certified hazmat disposal.
Record physical inventory write-off in system and issue scrap sale receipt.

fields.Trigger: Proof of Loss submitted (W5276) and adjuster evaluation report received

workflows.name: Insurance Settlement Negotiation and Recovery Accounting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated bank clearance matching settlement reference codes.
Controls: - CTL-29: accurate consolidated reporting; CFO sign-off on settlement releases.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss misclassification risk**: Recovery funds misbooked as operational revenue instead of capital asset offset, distorting EBITDA; mitigated by separate chart of accounts for insurance recoveries.

steps.activity: Review insurance settlement offer; compare valuation against BOQ.
Negotiate settlement adjustments with underwriter if discrepancies exist.
Accept final settlement offer and monitor fund transfer clearance.
Post insurance recovery journal entries and offset loss accounts in GL.

fields.Participants: Store Manager, LGU Building Inspector, LGU Disaster Risk Reduction Office
fields.Trigger: Disaster declaration or structural assessments completed (W5274)

workflows.name: LGU Civil Defense / Building Official Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - Online municipal portal submission module for permit applications.
Controls: - CTL-41: LGU permit compliance controls; VP Store Operations sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **City zoning violation risk**: Unpermitted construction on condemned sites triggers LGU fines and halts projects; mitigated by obtaining official LGU permit-to-rebuild approvals.

steps.activity: Notify local LGU building official and civil defense office of site status and damage details.
Coordinate LGU safety inspectors site visit to verify structural classification.
Register building "Condemned" or "Restricted" notices in municipal tracker.
Submit rebuilding permit package to City Planning/Zoning office.

fields.Participants: Store Manager, Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Insurance Administrator
fields.Trigger: Insurance settlement closed (W5278) and rebuilding project approved

workflows.name: Post-Disaster Incident Review and Hazard Mapping Update

Automation Opportunity: - Automated GIS map updates utilizing flood sensor and local weather agency data feeds.
Controls: - CTL-30: Month-end control standards; Audit Committee board review.
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (internal audit), VS-29 (master data), VS-26 (continuity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale risk modeling risk**: Future store site selections ignore updated flood/landslide risk parameters; mitigated by updating geodetic hazard database with current incident footprints.

steps.activity: Conduct post-disaster operational audit: evaluate response timeline, safety effectiveness, and damage scope.
Update corporate hazard maps and flood zone ratings in location master database.
Update business continuity plans (VS-26) with lessons learned from incident.
Present findings to Board Risk Committee.
